discovery_note: The four captured John 1:1 named searches are bounded candidate probes. P66, P75, 01, and 02 have verse coverage reviews for John 1:1-5. Discovery remains incomplete beyond this declared set.

witnesses.coverage_citation: International Greek New Testament Project, A Transcription of John in P66, version 2.1 (2013), TEI page P1, column 1, lines 2–8, verse elements B04K1V1–B04K1V5, https://epapers.bham.ac.uk/id/eprint/1759/10/04_P66.xml; NTVMR manuscript/get metadata for docID 10066, https://ntvmr.uni-muenster.de/community/vmr/api/metadata/manuscript/get/?docID=10066&detail=10&format=json, captured 2026-10-01 in tests/fixtures/p66_metadata_probe.json, labels pageID 10 as folio 1 with John 1:1-14; consulted 2026-10-01.
witnesses.coverage_reason: The IGNTP transcription records surviving Greek in each of John 1:1–5 on page P1, with no separate correction reading inside those verse elements. Some letters are supplied as lost or illegible, so the positive status is partial. Captured NTVMR metadata labels indexed page ID 10 as folio 1; the index also lists these verses on unlabeled page ID 3. The NTVMR index alone is not physical proof.

witnesses.unit_reason: The recorded positive text is the opening page's original copying; no separate correction reading is used for these five verse reviews.

witnesses.coverage_citation: INTF/NTVMR, GA 02 page 490, public microfilm image https://ntmss.info/images/webfriendly/20002/20002x00490XX_INTF.jpg, right column, lines 1-10; metadata https://ntvmr.uni-muenster.de/community/vmr/api/metadata/manuscript/get/?docID=20002&detail=10&format=json, captured in tests/fixtures/alexandrinus_metadata_probe.json; consulted 2026-10-01.
witnesses.coverage_reason: The inspected image shows surviving Greek for each of John 1:1-5 in the right column: verse 1 on lines 1-3, verse 2 on line 3, verse 3 on lines 4-6, verse 4 on lines 6-7, and verse 5 on lines 8-10. These positive portions are in the main text, without relying on marginal additions. Partial records identifiable surviving text, not certification of every letter or exact NA28 wording. The image bears both 66 and 42; NTVMR calls it folio 66r and assigns page 490. The British Library catalogue places the John opening on folio 42r; the foliation labels are retained separately.
